fields.description: Race board event 0, rank 1: rider/entrant id (low nibble selects rider name sprite).

fields.description: Two's-complement negation of the byte-sum checksum (~sum+1); baseline 0xFFFFF93D.
fields.evidence: FUN_080091e0 stores ~uVar5+1 at buffer+0xFC; FUN_08009080 rejects the save unless ~u32(+0xF8)+1 == (int)u32(+0xFC). Baseline holds 4294965565 = -1731 mod 2^32.
fields.name: checksum_negation
